description: This file defines options and extension methods for configuring Redis storage in Orleans grains, including connection setup, key generation, and serialization options.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptions
classes.description: Contains configurable options for Redis storage provider, including connection configuration, serializer, key generation, and lifecycle stage settings.

classes.name: RedisStorageOptionsExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring RedisStorageOptions, such as ignoring the grain type in Redis keys.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class used for redacting sensitive Redis configuration details in logging.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default asynchronous factory method for creating a Redis connection multiplexer using provided options.

methods.name: UseGetRedisKeyIgnoringGrainType
methods.description: Extension method to configure Redis keys to ignore grain type, useful for migration and compatibility.
